## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich brauche einen klaren Kopf.** — [ish BROW-khuh EYE-nen KLAH-ren kopf] — *I need a clear head.*
2. **Das hat mich zum Nachdenken gebracht.** — [das hat mish tsum NAHKH-den-ken guh-BRAHKHT] — *That made me think.*
3. **Lass dir Zeit damit.** — [lass deer tsayt dah-MIT] — *Take your time with it.*
